controls.name: no-limit
controls.find: pub open spec fn kept(rows:Seq<R>,limit:nat)->Seq<R> {if rows.len()<=limit {rows} else {rows.subrange(0,limit as int)}}
controls.classification: decision: the routes return every row (the Neo4j contract)

controls.name: api-counts-total
controls.find: pub open spec fn api(rows:Seq<R>,limit_rows:nat)->ApiAnswer {let k=kept(rows,limit_rows); ApiAnswer{rows:k,row_count:k.len()}}
controls.replace: pub open spec fn api(rows:Seq<R>,limit_rows:nat)->ApiAnswer {let k=kept(rows,limit_rows); ApiAnswer{rows:k,row_count:rows.len()}}
controls.classification: reporting: rowCount gives the query's total
